name: MIRE-2: Anomalous Flash/EEPROM Memory Checksums Detected
description: A checksum-disable command issued through the console AND the on-board Checksum app reporting integrity monitoring disabled in the same window — the attack command and its confirmed effect on the satellite together. The highest-confidence compromise signal.
query:
FROM logs.ecs.spacecraft.commands, logs.ecs.spacecraft.memory
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 hour
| EVAL disable_cmd = CASE(command.name == "CS_DISABLE_ALL_CS", 1, 0), cs_off = CASE(cs.checksumState == "DISABLED", 1, 0)
| STATS commands = SUM(disable_cmd), effects = SUM(cs_off)
| WHERE commands > 0 AND effects > 0
| KEEP commands, effects
| LIMIT 100
author: Elastic
false_positives: Authorized maintenance that both disables checksumming and issues the command will correlate. Tune per mission via detection exceptions.

## SPARTA Investigation Guide

### Detection logic
An ES|QL correlation over the command feed and the memory telemetry that fires when a checksum-disable command and the on-board checksum-disabled state both appear in the window — the attack command and its confirmed effect on the spacecraft.

### Framework reference
- **Tactic:** Execution
- **Technique EX-0004:** [Compromise Boot Memory](https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/EX-0004/)
- **Indicator of Behavior MIRE-2:** A memory-integrity command and its confirmed on-board effect, correlated.

### Indicators of Behavior
- **MIRE-2: A memory-integrity command and its confirmed on-board effect, correlated.**

### How to validate this alert
This is command-and-effect confirmed. Attribute via the operator user.name on the disable command, and respond as a live integrity compromise. See spartastixkb.
